description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Customs Ordinance Order under Section 19A
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - an order issued under Section 19A of the Customs Ordinance to exempt specific goods from customs import duties. It establishes regulatory conditions for duty waivers and outlines legal consequences for non-compliance, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) which includes statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and legal notices. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, so it does not qualify as a Hybrid gazette.
